messages.subject: return
messages.text:
Hello — 

I recently purchased a pair of your mittens to use to keep my Renaud’s-suffering hands warm on Chicago winter dog walks. I have worn them twice and, with great regret, would like to return them. 

They are so big and stiff and cumbersome that I can’t use my hands at all when wearing them. I have to take them off to use the poop bags, which kind of defeats the purpose. I also can’t feel that I’m holding anything when I wear them, so have dropped things without realizing it. It’s like wearing tennis rackets. I measured my hands and chose size M according to your instructions. But they just don’t work for me.

I no longer have the packing slip or receipt, but I’m sure you still have my information. Please let me know how to return them for a refund. 

Many thanks,

Carla Reiter

messages.subject: Re: return
messages.text:
Hello Carla,
 

 Here are the steps to follow for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Visit https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and postal code, you need to select the products to return and then choose the ones you want as replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, package the products to be returned, and attach the label to the package. Please use envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red mailbox or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once we receive the return, we will send the new product(s) and will request the exchange fee of $9.99 (only if applicable) 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-fondateur 
 Lasclay
